Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: her own room in a house of her element's kingdom, its walls and furniture built from the element's materials and colours, a mirror and a window
Time of day: night — the scene lit by lamps, screens or windows, dark outside; lamps lit inside, the window dark with night.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a thin-strap camisole with wrap shorts tied at the hip — in deep peacock teal; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 80-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 60-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: kneeling on the ground.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body in side profile, her face in profile too — only her eyes turn toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand rests on her knee — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: level lowered brow, steady unblinking eyes, mouth closed in a straight line, jaw set.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — meitnerium: a heavy synthetic metal below iridium, first made in 1982 in a research city as a single atom, and the only element named for one real woman alone: an exiled physicist who, on a snowy winter walk in a forest, sat on a fallen tree trunk and worked out on scraps of paper that a heavy nucleus can stretch like a trembling drop of liquid and split cleanly in two, releasing great energy; the prize for that discovery went to her colleague alone, and she refused all work on the weapon it made possible — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: lean and long-legged, with a natural neck length — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
